b1_gate: unchanged: atomic_mean>=0.85 AND both_frac>=0.60 AND both_n>=100; a B1-passing dev cell is recorded as ATOMIC_ACCESSIBILITY_RESCUED and stops Task 2; holdout is NEVER opened by Task 2
backbone: fully frozen; no finetuning; no LoRA

fixed_probe_recipe.scaler: StandardScaler fit on train readout only

holdout.status: SEALED, forbidden: DO NOT RENDER, DO NOT EXTRACT, DO NOT INSPECT, DO NOT OPEN

changed_mask.mapping: 512px abs-diff map block-averaged into 14 bins per axis via array_split (approximate patch correspondence; processor resizes 512->224 with no crop)
changed_mask.pixel_diff: mean over RGB of |I_edited - I_base| on canonical 512 renders, minus image median (removes uniform background offset; backgrounds differ across states by construction)
changed_mask.threshold: patch mean abs residual > 0.02 fixed BEFORE any feature-sensitivity result is computed

local_sensitivity.metric_secondary: normalized L2 stored for audit only; verdict keyed to d_cos

order: dinov3s then dinov3l for max size contrast; dinov3b added iff mechanism direction unclear; a formal S/B/L trend claim requires all three

primary_table.config: same LR recipe, same train_n=2000 quartets, same dev; per-model best configs are NOT primary evidence

processor: unchanged official pinned DINOv3ViTImageProcessor per model revision
purpose: fine spatial readout diagnostic: is the inverse size trend pooling loss (information present locally) or weak local patch sensitivity

readouts.R1: mean patches (cached, recomputed under fixed recipe)
readouts.R2: 2x2 spatial concat (cached, recomputed under fixed recipe)
readouts.R3: 4x4 adaptive_avg_pool2d over 14x14 patch grid, concat 16*C, same linear LR
readouts.R4: 7x7 adaptive_avg_pool2d over 14x14 patch grid, concat 49*C, same linear LR
readouts.R5: oracle-localized diagnostic ONLY: 3x3 patches around relation locus (segment-segment closest midpoint, input geometry only), averaged to C-dim, same linear LR; privileged geometry, never a performance claim; 14x14 flatten excluded from primary matrix

run_priority: dinov3s, dinov3l, then dinov3b iff needed
selection: NO model/readout selection by composition metric; comp_miss not computed/shown for new readouts; all B1-fail history only

splits.train: existing bridge_r train v2 (2164 quartets); fixed train_n=2000 first quartet IDs shared across S/B/L

statistics: quartet-unit paired bootstrap, 10000 resamples: per-readout A_S-A_L with 95% CI; per-scale A_R3-A_R0, A_R4-A_R0, A_R5-A_R0 with 95% CI
